# sig9

> sig9 is an IT and cybersecurity consulting firm in Zurich, Switzerland.
> We help companies design secure software, consolidate their IT
> infrastructure and protect digital assets. Services: security audits,
> pentests and code reviews, secure software and infrastructure design,
> Bitcoin/blockchain and Web3 engineering, key ceremonies and secrets
> management, blockchain intelligence.

## Security Bulletins

Daily cybersecurity intelligence, published as "Hacker Wars". Each
bulletin summarizes the day's most relevant attacks, vulnerabilities
and patches, and closes with concrete defensive recommendations.

- [Security bulletins index](https://sig9.ch/bulletin/): every daily bulletin, newest first.
- [RSS feed](https://sig9.ch/bulletin/index.xml): full-text feed, one item per day.
